summary: A datagram socket as a DHCP client uses it, connected to one peer, sharing a port and broadcasting, on the rtl8139

cases.behavior: dgramprobe passes each row at the debug shell, refusing a datagram the host sends from outside through the forward, and its broadcast to 255.255.255.255 at port 7500 is on the wire of the rtl8139

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine when the scenario did not power it off

steps.does: boot the test image to the debug shell
run dgramprobe at the debug shell, send it a datagram from the host with hostpeer send through the forward when it prints DGRAMPROBE OUTSIDE, and take its report from the console
power the machine off at the debug shell and wait for its end, which makes the capture whole
run pcapcheck bcast on the capture of the card for the broadcast to 255.255.255.255 at port 7500

assertions.checks: a write on a datagram socket with no peer answers EDESTADDRREQ
a connected socket writes to its peer without an address, and the peer receives the bytes written
a connected socket has a source port for a reply
a connected socket receives its peer's reply and not a third local socket's datagram, which is counted as refused
a connected socket does not receive the datagram the host sends through the forward after DGRAMPROBE OUTSIDE, which is counted as refused
the socket that refused the outsider still receives its peer
a connect on the console's descriptor answers ENOTSOCK
a two-byte AF_UNSPEC connect disconnects a datagram socket, and a later write answers EDESTADDRREQ
a two-byte AF_UNSPEC connect of a stream socket answers EAFNOSUPPORT
a connect of each of eight packet sockets answers EOPNOTSUPP
after the eight packet sockets a datagram socket still binds a port
a second bind of a bound port answers EADDRINUSE until both sockets set SO_REUSEADDR, then succeeds even when different file-system user ids opened and bound the sockets
of two sockets on one port, the reply goes to the one connected to the sender, and the listener does not take it
closing one of two sockets on a port leaves the other bound
uid 1000 binding port 68 answers EACCES
a connect beside eight bound sockets answers 0 or EAGAIN
a send to 255.255.255.255 and to the subnet's broadcast answers EACCES without SO_BROADCAST
with SO_BROADCAST set, a send to 255.255.255.255 at port 7500 is sent
SO_BROADCAST and SO_REUSEADDR read back as set
SO_BINDTODEVICE takes eth0 by name, answers ENODEV for eth9, and unbinds with an empty name
SO_BINDTODEVICE takes the whole struct ifreq that BusyBox sends, and reads back as the name
the machine powers off at the debug shell's command after the probe, so that the capture is whole
pcapcheck bcast finds the probe's broadcast datagram to 255.255.255.255 at port 7500 in the capture of the card

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case sends a datagram through the forward of QEMU's user network to the guest's port 7502 and finds the probe's broadcast in QEMU's capture of the card; tests/native/probes.cases runs the probe's rows natively
